meta.source: Re-based on Asya Abdrahman's seven art-direction boards (colour sampled from her paintings, paper reliefs and Abjad series). Type chosen with the team; Fraunces, Karla and IBM Plex Mono (SIL OFL) bundled as Latin-subset woff2 from Fontsource.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Default page and slide ground; hero vignettes fall off to it. Every text colour below is checked on it.

tokens.name: char
tokens.usage: Raised ground: cards, panels, hung-frame wall, table bodies on ink. Flame, bone, ash, teal, clay and glow all pass on it.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Alternate layer in a stack, and the tall vertical panels beside an aperture. Same text rules as char.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Fill of a panel hung in its frame and of node cards. Flame, bone, ash and glow text only; teal and clay fail here.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Timber: frame rails and table label cells. A fill. Flame, bone and glow text pass on it; ash and clay fail.

tokens.name: clay
tokens.usage: Mid-value workhorse that reads as material: large slabs and fills; eyebrow labels on ink, char and ground. Not text on panel or field.

tokens.name: rust
tokens.usage: Deep warm end of a fill or gradient. Decorative.

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: Warm accent: the inner ring of a node, secondary fills. Text on it is on-glow.

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: The light. Small areas only: rings, panel titles, links, emphasis phrases, the focus ring. One focal glow per composition. On ink, char, ground, panel and field.

tokens.name: glow-core
tokens.usage: Near-white hot core at the centre of a glow, a few percent of the glowing area. Fill only.

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: Twine, table grids and structural hairlines. 3:1+ on ink, char, ground and field.

tokens.name: verdigris
tokens.usage: Cool shadow. Decorative fills only, never text.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Cool accent and uppercase labels on ink, char and ground. Never on panel. Cool appears as light on warm surfaces.

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: Pulp register base: surfaces and held objects. Fill.

tokens.name: lavender
tokens.usage: Pulp midtone, reads as light on cool paper. Fill.

tokens.name: viol
tokens.usage: Light end of a pulp surface. Fill.

tokens.name: ultramarine
tokens.usage: Deepest note. Pools in recesses and creases, never on a face. Fill.

tokens.name: mark
tokens.usage: The glossy near-black mark: strokes, pips, counters, rank marks. Constant on every ground. Fill.

tokens.name: flame
tokens.usage: Titles and ledes on ink, char, ground, panel and field.

tokens.name: bone
tokens.usage: Body copy on ink, char, ground, panel and field.

tokens.name: ash
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and control borders on ink, char, ground and panel. Not on field (4.4:1).

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Quiet dividers and card edges on ink and char. Decorative only.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Panel frames and stack dividers. Decorative; a control's border uses ash.

tokens.name: on-glow
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on glow, ember and clay fills.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero and title-slide headlines, in flame.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Slide and page section titles, in flame.

styles.name: quote
styles.usage: Pull quotes and closing lines, in glow.

styles.name: node-label
styles.usage: The name inside a hub ring, in glow.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: The true currency is human resilience.
styles.usage: Statement above body copy in flame; bold the closing phrase in glow.

styles.name: panel-title
styles.usage: Title of a panel or layer card, in glow.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Technology is merely the infrastructure; the community is the asset.
styles.usage: Long-form body on web pages and slides, in bone.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Entities like Primordia and Kin DAO executing decentralized governance.
styles.usage: Panel and card body, table cells, in bone.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase category labels and eyebrows (CARE, CULTURE, LAND, SCALING), in teal, clay or flame.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inline gaps, icon-to-text.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Panel padding (compact), table cell vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel and table cell padding, gutters between cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between a section title and its content.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Slide margins and gaps between sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Hero and title-slide margins.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Panels, tables, frames: structure stays square; softness lives in what hangs and in illustration.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Small interactive elements that need a hint of softening.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Rings, node discs, seed dots and the knots on twine.

shadow.note: The brand has no drop shadows; light is glow, a warm bloom behind a glowing element. Glow or shimmer, never both.

tokens.name: glow-sm
tokens.usage: Node rings, seed dots, small emissive objects.

tokens.name: glow-lg
tokens.usage: The one focal point of a composition: hub ring, aperture.

stroke.note: Line weights for frames, rings and twine.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Table grid, panel borders, dividers.

tokens.name: stroke-ring
tokens.usage: Node rings and slide frames.

tokens.name: stroke-thread
tokens.usage: Twine on a hung panel.
